Our Story

A quieter
way to gather.

Coffee, craft, and conversation — without the noise.

Modern Circle began as a small idea: a calm, non-smoking space in El Mourouj where mornings feel unhurried, work feels possible, and every object on the shelf has been chosen with care. Six years on, it remains exactly that — a sanctuary for slow days and handmade things.

Our Values

Handmade,
heartmade.

Local First

We source from Tunisian farms, roasters and artisans whose work we know by name.

Less, Better

A short menu of considered things, made well, served slowly. Nothing wasted.

Soft Footprint

Compostable take-away, ceramic on the table, refillable everywhere we can.

Open Doors

A welcoming space for working alone, gathering quietly, or simply pausing.

Slow Hands

Every cake, every loaf, every plate is made in-house each morning.

Honest Pricing

Fair to the maker, fair to you. No surprises.
